maria: pushed fixes for PR #1427 — addressed comments about autoscale config, removed dead code in batcher, added unit + integration tests. PTAL when you have a minute :eyes:
sam: nice. one quick q: did you keep the default max_batch_size? looks like you set 128 -> 64 in commit 3
maria: yeah changed to 64 because of latency SLOs, added a comment explaining tradeoff. the perf tests still pass locally
alex: CI is showing a flaky test in test_batcher::eviction_timeout, probably unrelated, rerunning
ci-bot: re-run triggered by @alex — CI build #4872 started
priya: left one tiny nit about log verbosity (use debug instead of info) — otherwise LGTM
maria: good catch, fixed and pushed (sha abc1234)
jia: on it. will review end of day. can you squash the WIP commits? makes history easier
maria: squashed and force-pushed
ci-bot: CI build #4872 completed — 1 failed, 2 passed
sam: looks like test_batcher timed out again. could be timing flakiness. maria can you add a retry in the test harness? or mark as flaky with ticket
maria: added retries in test (deterministic wait + seed) and flagged flaky test in issue #260. pushed new commit
ci-bot: CI build #4875 started
ci-bot: CI build #4875 passed — all checks green :tada:
jia: reviewed — left one comment about a null-check but it's optional. approving after that.
priya: approved :+1:

maria: thanks all — merging to main in ~5m unless anyone objects
alex: no objections, thanks

sam: nice work, excited to see the optimizations live :rocket:
